# WINVN Coffee Wood Chew

> WINVN INT CO., LTD is a Vietnam-based manufacturer of natural coffee wood dog chews. Founded by Ton That Nhat Cam, a native of Vietnam's Tay Nguyen (Central Highlands) coffee region, WINVN turns coffee wood discarded after ~20 years of coffee-tree life into safe, natural, biodegradable pet chews — creating extra income for coffee farmers and a sustainable product for pet owners. WINVN now produces over 5 million pieces per year and exports to 40+ countries.

## Company
- Legal name: WINVN INT CO., LTD
- Founder & Director: Ton That Nhat Cam
- Origin: Tay Nguyen (Gia Lai, Dak Lak), Vietnam
- Address: 70 Street 10, Van Phuc Urban Area, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- Email (sales): Sale@winvnint.com
- Website: https://www.winvnint.com

## Products
WINVN's core product is the Coffee Wood Chew — a natural dog chew stick made from 100% coffee wood, no chemicals, no artificial flavors. Four product lines:
- Coffee Wood Chew (code CC01) — basic line, 6 sizes (XS–XXL)
- Gorilla Wood Chew (code GRL) — extra-dense chew for aggressive chewers, 4 sizes (S–XL)
- Coffee Wood Chew With Cotton — coffee wood combined with natural cotton rope, 7 shapes (codes CC02, CC04, CC06, CC08, CC10, CC12, CC14)
- Coffee Wood Chew With Rope (hemp) — coffee wood combined with natural hemp/jute rope, 7 shapes (codes CC03, CC05, CC07, CC09, CC11, CC13, CC15)

Full catalog: https://www.winvnint.com/products

## Services (OEM/ODM)
- Flexible MOQ from 50 units to bulk container orders
- Laser logo engraving on wood
- Custom packaging: vacuum-sealed bags, kraft paper bags, cloth pouches
- Custom label and sticker design
- Custom branded boxes, from multi-product cartons to single-piece gift boxes
- Worldwide shipping with full export documentation (phytosanitary, certificate of origin, fumigation)
- Free marketing kit (product photos and videos) included with orders
- 1-for-1 replacement guarantee for defects on WINVN's side

Details: https://www.winvnint.com/oem

## Certifications
WINVN ships with full export documentation, viewable on the homepage: Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, Fumigation Certificate, and in-house Quality Control inspection records.

## Manufacturing Process
Coffee wood is sourced from farmers in Gia Lai and Dak Lak, transported to WINVN's factory, sun-dried for about a week, precision-cut to size, hand-sanded and smoothed for pet safety, machine-dried to under 12% moisture, vacuum-sealed, quality-inspected (smell, color, moisture, size), then packed into cartons for export.

Full story and process: https://www.winvnint.com/manufacturing
